name: Handwoven sabai grass wall decor plates, set of 3 (8/10/12 in), Odisha handicraft
supplier_cost_note: OJs Visit Arena, Bhubaneswar (Odisha): 'Assorted Sabai Grass Baskets, For Decoration, Size 8x3, 10x3 and 12x3 Inches' Rs 700/set, excl. taxes and shipping, in stock (IndiaMART, seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshot; seller rating 3.5 from 2 reviews). Alternatives: Sigmascott Pvt Ltd, Bhubaneswar: 'Sabai Grass Woven Wall Plate - Set of 3 (8/10/12 in)' 249 INR per unit, MOQ 50 (TradeIndia) - unit (per set vs per plate) ambiguous, could cut cost sharply if per set; Sigmascott single round wall plate Rs 199/piece, MOQ 10, size 'customised' (IndiaMART); Craft Vista Baripada wall plate Rs 350/piece. Get written quote for the exact 8/10/12 in set with photos.
retail_observed: Sets of 3 sabai grass wall plates: Gunmala Rs 1,250 (smaller 6/8/10 in); Utkalika Odisha Rs 1,560 sale (out of stock); Bhumee Creations Rs 1,799 (Amazon.in); star-pattern set Rs 2,050 (Amazon.in); Gulaabi Ghar Rs 2,490 (Amazon.in); The State Square Rs 2,490; DIYBaazar Rs 3,599. Seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshots. No comparable 8/10/12 in set found well below Rs 1,250.

demand_signals.summary: Multiple sellers (Gulaabi Ghar, Bhumee Creations, Bhartiye Crafts, Jaypore, Swadeh, Whispering Homes) list sets of 3/5/7/9 at Rs 1,799-2,490; some listings show low stock (no sales volumes available)

risks: Parcel: actual weight not stated; a 12 in plate nested set packs ~32x32x6-8 cm, volumetric ~1.2-1.6 kg, so le_2kg slab used; le_1kg only if packed flatter
Amazon/Flipkart above Rs 1,000 carry 12% referral in the model, so margin there is ~21-22% at Rs 1,599; base case relies on Shopify/Meesho
Supplier is a trader with only 2 reviews; confirm maker, colours and that 8x3/10x3/12x3 in are wall-hanging plates (hook/loop) not bowls
Handmade colour/size variation -> 'not as pictured' returns; state variation in listing
Moisture/mould in storage; crush damage in courier if not boxed
GST: HSN 4602 basketwork; 5% assumed (handicraft rate cut Sept 2025); at 12% margin drops ~5 points - CA to confirm
Odisha supplier: GST-local, eligible for Amazon/Flipkart/Meesho pickup

review.notes: Deciding fact unconfirmed: the only Rs 700/set quote is a trader (OJs Visit Arena, 3.5 stars from 2 reviews) whose listing says 'baskets' 8x3/10x3/12x3 in, not confirmed as hooped wall plates, and the Sigmascott 8/10/12 in set is indexed as Rs 249 'per piece', MOQ 20 (search snippet of the TradeIndia listing) - if per plate the set costs Rs 747 and Shopify/Meesho fall to 29.8% (Amazon/Flipkart ~18-19%), only if per set does it clear easily; at Rs 700 it passes only Shopify/Meesho (33%) on the le_2kg slab. Price is not a differentiator: the identical 8/10/12 in set sells at Rs 1,599 (Grasscrafts) and Rs 1,560 (Utkalika), so get a written Sigmascott/maker quote stating per-set price, hoop on back, colours, packed box size and weight before any sample.
